newsitem.title: USA: Trump Hotels Taj Mahal Sept revs rise.
newsitem.headline: Trump Hotels Taj Mahal Sept revs rise.

text.p: Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc said on Thursday that its Trump Taj Mahal casino reported gaming revenues of $57.4 million in September, compared with $46.4 million in the year ago period.
Trump Plaza Hotel reported September revenues of $34.5 million, up from $25.9 million in September 1995, the company said.
Trump's Trump Castle, which was not part of the publicly traded company until September 30, posted September revenues of $20.38 million versus $28.97 million in September 1995, a spokeswoman said.
The company said its riverboat property in Buffington Harbor, Indiana is exceeding expectations but did not provide any details.
